payload.title: Pin Decision Models Are Not Calculators draft content for review
payload.description: As an Anth.us editor, I want the Gatsby site to point at the reviewed content revision so that the article and social preview can be built before publication. Scope: pin the anthus-site-content draft commit on a site branch, run the production build, open a pull request against develop, and do not merge or deploy without approval. Given the content PR with state: draft, when the site submodule points to its commit, then the Gatsby build includes the draft article and its 1200x630 cover.
